item.text: For a provided topic, `get_relevant_context` does a pure-symbolic lookup through the cache-coherent entity index via `entity_index.search_classes()`, then filters the topic hits with a relevance floor of `0.45` before formatting them as `ContextItem`s. I relied on the recorded entries **“get_relevant_context: pure-symbolic context retrieval via entity index (topic) or list-all (no topic)”** and **“get_relevant_context: relevance floor (0.45) drops noise hits; topic-aware empty-state is honest”**.
